newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti unit in 35 bln lire Helsinki deal.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti unit in 35 bln lire Helsinki deal.

text.p: Italy's Olivetti said a consortium led by Olivetti Systems and Services has won a contract worth 35 billion lire to supply automatic ticketing machines for the Helsinki city transport company YTV.
Three Finnish companies are part of the consortium, one of which Buscom Oy will be responsible for supplying equipment for vehicles and proximity cards, a type of electronic payment.

An Olivetti statement said the new ticketing system, to be brought in from the beginning of next year, will cover Helsinki's above-ground transport, the metropolitan network, railways and local ferries, carrying a total of 250 million passengers a year.
